subject: Mid-cycle capacity amendment and invoice offset for HeliosAI
messages:
From: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@heliosai.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@heliosai.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: add 10 vGPU-capacity mid-billing-cycle (Nov)

Hi Aditya / Monica,

Quick one — we went live on a pilot yesterday and need an additional 10 vGPU capacity for the rest of November to handle a customer spike. Can Redwood bill a partial-month charge for the extra capacity and apply it to our November invoice? Also want to confirm whether VAT is applicable for this partial charge — HeliosAI is US-based but has EU customers.

We can sign any amendment needed. Need this by end of next week if possible.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Bell
Head of Platform Ops, HeliosAI
--
Jordan.Bell@heliosai.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@heliosai.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: add 10 vGPU-capacity mid-billing-cycle (Nov)

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the pilot launch. We can absolutely add capacity mid-cycle and bill prorated for the remaining days of November. High-level notes: 

- Charge model: we’ll compute a daily pro-rata on the committed monthly rate for the 10 additional vGPU-equivalents and charge you only for the remainder of the invoice period (Nov 20–30).
- Invoice posting: we can either include the partial charge as a separate interim invoice (preferred for bookkeeping) or net it against the Nov month-end invoice — you indicated preference for a single line item on your month-end invoice. We can do that.
- VAT handling: Because HeliosAI is a US-registered company, we will not apply EU VAT on this short-term capacity add if the billing entity is HeliosAI US and we have a US tax id on file. If you need the capacity billed to an EU entity, we’ll need the EU VAT number and we may zero-rate or apply local VAT per local rules.

Action items from Redwood: 
1) I’ll loop in Billing to generate a one-line offset charge and attach an interim invoice number for your records.
2) Monica will prepare an amendment to the MPA that lists the temporary capacity add and the exact dates.
3) Rishi will confirm VAT logic and attach any required tax forms.

Is a single consolidated month-end invoice okay, or do you prefer the interim invoice now? If consolidated, we’ll post an invoice reference on the Nov 30 statement.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0172
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@heliosai.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: add 10 vGPU-capacity mid-billing-cycle (Nov) — amendment + invoice

Jordan — looping Billing and Finance Ops here for transparency. Per our conversation: attaching a short amendment (MPA-HeliosAI-signed.pdf) that adds 10 vGPU-equivalents from 2026-11-20 through 2026-11-30. The total pro-rated charge for the 10 vGPU add-on is $4,150.00 (USD).

We will follow your preference to have this appear as a single line item on your Nov 30 statement. However, for bookkeeping / payments we will issue an interim invoice number now so your AP team has a reference; the charge will be reconciled on the month-end statement. Invoice reference: INV-20261121-HLX. You will see the interim invoice attached (invoice-20261121.pdf) and the amount will be reflected on the Nov 30 consolidated invoice.

VAT: Rishi — HeliosAI confirmed US billing entity. Please confirm whether we should apply any VAT or include a note for EU customers that consumed the workload (Jordan — please advise if you need an EU invoice).

Jordan, next steps:
- Please confirm you’re happy with the amendment dates and sign the attached PDF.
- Confirm whether you want a separate EU invoice; otherwise we’ll proceed under US billing details on file.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: MPA-HeliosAI-signed.pdf (amendment), invoice-20261121.pdf (interim invoice stub)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Bell <jordan.bell@heliosai.com>, monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: add 10 vGPU-capacity mid-billing-cycle (Nov) — VAT follow-up

Jordan — quick VAT note: since the billing entity on file is HeliosAI US (EIN on file), Redwood will not apply EU VAT to the interim partial-month charge. If you need that charge to be issued to an EU legal entity, send the EU VAT number and billing legal name and we’ll re-issue with appropriate VAT treatment (either reverse-charge or local VAT depending on country).

For audit trail we will: 
- reference INV-20261121-HLX on the Nov 30 consolidated invoice
- attach the signed MPA amendment to your account record and the invoice PDF

Jordan — once you confirm the amendment and that US billing is correct, we’ll post the interim invoice and mark it as reconciled on the month-end statement.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Manager, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
